CustomField.description: How many days a Delinquency Case may go without a Case Comment before it flags as stale (FSD 5.9.7 trigger 6 and the FSD 6.5 no-follow-up list). There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Flag a Case as needing follow-up after this many quiet days.
CustomField.label: Stale Follow Up Days
